estimands.sister_event: A_j(s)=1[N_j(b+s)>0], living descendants of newborn daughter j at common elapsed lag s.
estimands.sister_covariance: Cov(A_1(s),A_2(s) | qualifying division and relevant common context).
estimands.pair_eligibility: Birth/past information plus predeclared administrative support; no future survival or completeness restriction.
estimands.horizon_statistic: Q_T(t)=P(prospective random tag alive at t | N_founder(T)>0), compared at common absolute t.
not_equivalent: fate restricted to eventual death or division

identifiability.tier: project analytic reasoning; no new numerical result
identifiability.independent_renewal_null: Conditional daughter-subtree independence implies zero sister covariance.
identifiability.perfect_shared_type: Conditional independence implies Var_w[h_Z(s)], with eligible-pair weights w.
identifiability.permanent_environment_equivalence: Identical conditional tree kernels K_z and mixing probabilities imply identical P(O)=sum_z pi_z K_z(O), hence all observable tree statistics are identical.
identifiability.scope_limit: This overlap blocks a universal discriminator between broad classes; it does not identify every partially transmitting type model with a permanent environment.
identifiability.blind_spot: Different types may have equal subtree-survival probability at chosen lags.

boundaries: Local asymptotic only; not full Erlang distribution or global horizon invariance.
Fixed positive T with positive family inclusion and t<=T.
One newborn founder and independent renewal daughters/death clocks; no atom at zero division.
Fate-independent forward tag, never replaced after death.
Mixed initial age/stage changes residual division law; disappearance of high order need not mean linear onset.
Pre-existing sister branches at observation origin define a different sampling model.
Precise regularity and remainder bounds await separate mathematical review.
